summary.text: Paul Feeney is a Democratic state senator from Massachusetts who has represented the Bristol and Norfolk District since 2017 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He chairs the Joint Committee on Financial Services.

paragraphs.text: Feeney assumed office in 2017 and advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.
For the 2025-2026 session he chairs the Joint Committee on Financial Services and is assistant vice chair of the Senate Ways and Means Committee and the Joint Committee on Ways and Means.

He was also assigned to the Senate Personnel and Administration Committee and the Joint Committees on Economic Development and Emerging Technologies, Health Care Financing, Housing, and Labor and Workforce Development.
